heroDescription: One restricted credit balance you can use at participating restaurants under their current partner agreements.
disclaimerTitle: Stored-value credit, not a bank account
disclaimerBody: OxSteed Credit is not a deposit account, cash balance, or promise of bank services. Spending is limited to the partners and terms shown below.
pausedBody: Your balance and history remain available. New Credit spending is paused while the network is being reviewed.
guardrailsCopy: These limits help protect your restricted balance. Reservations count toward spending until they are captured, released, or expired.
authorizeCopy: Choose a participating restaurant and reserve the exact amount. The cashier can capture it once, and the hold expires automatically if it is not used.
holdIdInstruction: Give this hold ID to the cashier
holdDetails: It is for {{amount}} and expires {{date}}. Never share your account password.
holdsCopy: Active reservations reduce your spendable balance until captured, released, or expired. Completed reservations stay here so you can reconcile every temporary balance change.
cancelAuthorizationCopy: Cancel an authorization if you will not use it. This immediately returns the reserved amount to your spendable balance.
partnerNetworkCopy: Only active restaurants with a current agreement appear here. The list is the source of truth for where your balance can be used today.
partnerHidden: Partner restaurants are hidden until your OxSteed Credit account is active. Contact support if you need help.
creditBecomesSpendable: OxSteed Credit becomes spendable as participating restaurants are activated.
tryAnother: Try another restaurant, city, or order type.
termsFallback: Use is subject to the active partner agreement and restaurant terms.
statementCopy: Every balance change is recorded in the OxSteed Credit ledger with a timestamp and transaction type. Showing {{from}} through {{to}}.
activityCopy: Your credit activity will appear here when a load, purchase, transfer, or refund is posted.
disputeCopy: This creates a review record without changing your balance automatically. If the connection drops, submitting the same form again is safe.
disputesCopy: Disputes are reviewed separately from your balance. A status change never edits the original ledger entry.
transactionDescription: Review the posted details for this OxSteed Credit balance change. Your access is limited to your own account activity.
incorrectEntryCopy: If this entry looks incorrect or you do not recognize it, report it from your Credit activity list. A dispute creates a review record without changing your balance automatically.
errorLoad: Unable to load OxSteed Credit right now.
chooseEligibleAmount: Choose an eligible restaurant and enter a valid amount.
authorizationCreated: Authorization created. Give the hold ID to the cashier.
conversionCopy: Use an approved, unexpired quote. OxSteed never estimates exchange rates or combines currencies automatically.
conversionQuoteRequired: Enter a valid quote ID and source amount.
conversionQuoteMismatch: The quote is expired, unavailable, or does not match this currency and amount.
holdIdCopyError: Unable to copy the hold ID.
disputeSubmitted: Your dispute was submitted for review.
partnerActivityDescription: Review restricted-credit purchases and settlement records for this restaurant. Customer identity stays private.
noPartnerActivity: No OxSteed Credit activity has posted for this restaurant.
noSettlementRecords: No settlement records have been created yet.
partnerActivityError: OxSteed Credit partner activity could not be loaded.
partnerReportError: OxSteed Credit report could not be downloaded.
adminCustomerAccessDescription: Access is assigned per partner agreement. Keep the same customer ID and submit another agreement to authorize spending at multiple restaurants. This does not move balance or bypass the agreement's own rules.
adminUnableLoadAccess: Unable to load customer restaurant access.
adminAccessCsvDownloaded: Customer access CSV downloaded with the active filters.
adminUnableExportAccess: Unable to export customer restaurant access.
adminAccessAlreadyCurrent: That customer access record was already up to date.
adminBulkAccessCustomerAndReasonRequired: Customer UUID and a reason are required for bulk customer access.
adminBulkAccessAgreementRequired: Select at least one restaurant agreement for bulk customer access.
adminBulkAccessAlreadyApplied: That bulk customer access action was already applied.
adminBulkAccessSaved: Customer access saved across {{count}} restaurant agreements.
adminBulkAccessFailed: Bulk customer access update failed. No partial changes were saved.
adminBulkAccessCurrencyMismatch: Selected agreements use different currencies. Clear the limits or select agreements sharing one currency.
adminInvalidLimitAmount: Enter a valid positive amount in {{currency}}, or leave the limit blank.
adminCustomerUuidPlaceholder: Paste UUID or choose from loaded wallets
adminAgreementSearchHelp: Use Find agreements to search beyond the initial agreement list.
adminAuthorizeMultipleRestaurants: Authorize the same customer at multiple restaurants
adminUnableLoadRestaurantLedger: Unable to load the restaurant Credit ledger.
adminReserveFundedNotice: Restaurant reserve funded and recorded in the immutable Credit ledger.
adminReserveReleasedNotice: Restaurant reserve release recorded in the immutable Credit ledger.
adminRestaurantLedgerDescription: Each restaurant has its own payable account and protected reserve account. Funding records are immutable and require a reason, idempotency key, and external reference; this does not claim that a bank transfer occurred outside the system.
adminReserveMovementDescription: Funding moves value from the central treasury account into this restaurant reserve. Release reverses that movement. It cannot directly change restaurant payable earnings.
adminReserveReasonPlaceholder: Why is this reserve movement authorized?
adminCustomerProfileDescription: One read-only view of this customer wallet, all restaurant assignments, reserved funds, and ledger history. Assignment rows can cover multiple restaurants without combining their agreements or currencies.
adminUnableDownloadCustomerStatement: Unable to download this customer Credit statement.
adminUnableLoadCustomerProfile: Unable to load this customer Credit profile.
